## Dataset removal request

This template is for asking us to delete a mirrored dataset. Open a pull request that removes the relevant folder, then complete every item below.

### Dataset

- Directory to remove:
- Files inside it (or “entire directory”):
- Original source, if known (see `original_urls` in [lawrennd/ods](https://github.com/lawrennd/ods/blob/main/pods/data_resources.yml)):

### Authority

Under what authority are you requesting this removal? Tick one and name the rights holder.

- [ ] I am the copyright holder
- [ ] I am authorised to act for the copyright holder
- [ ] I published or hosted the original dataset
- [ ] I am a data subject, or I act for a data subject (personal data)
- [ ] I am serving a court order, regulatory notice, or similar legal demand
- [ ] Other (explain below)

Name of the rights holder or organisation:

Your relationship to that person or organisation:

Contact email for follow-up:

### Reason

- [ ] Copyright or licence
- [ ] Privacy or personal data
- [ ] The original publisher withdrew the data
- [ ] Sensitive, confidential, or otherwise restricted material
- [ ] Other (explain below)

Please explain the request in enough detail that we can assess it.

### Ruling or notice

If a court, regulator, publisher, or other body has already ruled or given notice, point us at it. A public citation is enough when the material is public. If the ruling is confidential, give a contact who can confirm it; do not paste the confidential text into this pull request.

- Public URL, docket, or citation (preferred):
- If confidential, contact name, role, and address or email for verification:
- Date of the ruling or notice, if known:

### Checklist

- [ ] This pull request deletes only the dataset named above
- [ ] I have stated my authority and named the rights holder
- [ ] I have stated the reason for removal
- [ ] I have given a public reference to the ruling or notice, or a contact who can confirm a confidential ruling
- [ ] The information I have given is accurate to the best of my knowledge
- [ ] I understand that maintainers may ask for further evidence before merging
- [ ] I understand that GitHub’s [copyright dispute process](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/content-removal-policies/dmca-takedown-policy) remains available for copyright claims

If we merge this pull request, we will drop the corresponding download URL in [lawrennd/ods](https://github.com/lawrennd/ods).
